Quest name: The Hero Who Shines in the Night Sky (Chrono Quest - 3rd period, 18th Century)
Quest location: St. Petersburg Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r8 Recognition, r10 Astronomy, SPA(Spanish)
Pre-requisite discovery: Cetus discovery (from "Investigation of the Sea Monster" quest) + Algol discovery (from "Observation Record of Bright Stars" map)
